notes: Major accuracy fix for wrong-country companies: some real companies never state their own country/city anywhere on their site, so no amount of text-pattern matching could catch them (verified real cases: two companies were confirmed Indian via web search, but nothing in their crawled text said so). The tool now does a real, targeted search for any company it still can't place after all the earlier checks, and uses those results to make the final call - this closes the gap completely for the cases we found, at the cost of a small amount of added time only for the companies that actually need it. Reminder: if a run still looks thin or off for a market, first check that your DEEPSEEK_API_KEY in .env is a valid, working key.
